normalized.description: The purpose of the activity is to coordinate satcom sector involvement in the 5G standardisation process of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP). The activity scope includes building consensus amongst satcom players, developing contributions to support standardisation actions, and advocating positions favourable to the sector within the standardisation process. The activity goal being to ensure that the standardisation process results in tangible new opportunities for the satcom industry.
